name: pumi-csv-viewer
description: CSV, TSV and other delimited files as a table: sort, search, resize columns, copy and edit cells, and save them back.

header.label: Header row
header.desc: `Guess` treats the first row as names when it looks like names: no blanks, no repeats, and a column under it that holds numbers.

delimiter.label: Delimiter
delimiter.desc: `Guess` reads the first lines and takes the one field separator they agree on; `.tsv` and `.tab` are tabs, `.psv` is pipes.

numbers.label: Right-align numbers
numbers.desc: A column whose values are mostly numbers has them lined up on the right, and sorts them as numbers rather than as text.

striped.label: Striped rows
striped.desc: Tint every other row, so a wide row is followed across the page.

watch_file.label: Follow the file
watch_file.desc: Read the file again when something rewrites it, which is what a script that regenerates it does.

labels: As wide as they need, scrolling sideways
Squeezed to share the pane's width
columns.label: Column widths
columns.desc: `As wide as they need` keeps each column at the width its contents ask for and lets the table scroll sideways when that is wider than the pane; `Squeezed` shares the pane's width out between them instead. The button in the table's bar flips it.

max_rows.label: Rows at most
max_rows.desc: A file with more rows than this shows the first of them, with a note saying how many were left. Searching and sorting see only those.

commands.title: CSV Viewer: read the file again
